# Function: createAgent()

```ts
function createAgent(def: AgentDefinition): AgentDefinition;

```

Pure factory for agent definitions: cycle-detects the sub-agent graph and returns the same object, stamped with a non-enumerable AGENT\_BRAND so discovery recognizes it. Safe at module top-level; no adapter is built. Don't `Object.freeze` the definition before passing it in — the brand is written onto the argument.

## Parameters[​](#parameters "Direct link to Parameters")

| Parameter | Type                                                                      |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `def`     | [`AgentDefinition`](./docs/api/appkit/Interface.AgentDefinition.md) |

## Returns[​](#returns "Direct link to Returns")

[`AgentDefinition`](./docs/api/appkit/Interface.AgentDefinition.md)

## Example[​](#example "Direct link to Example")

```ts
const support = createAgent({
  instructions: "You help customers.",
  model: "databricks-claude-sonnet-4-5",
  tools: {
    get_weather: tool({ ... }),
  },
});

```
